row.runner: ubuntu-latest x16; core tests/browser-wpt/wpt-reftests.py, CPU raster, Noto Sans

rules: Every reftest item of the WPT manifest at wpt_commit under the suite's directory (print reftests are a separate kind), run by core tests/browser-wpt/wpt-reftests.py by wptrunner's rules: == and != references, reference chains, fuzzy annotations, the test's viewport size (800x600 by default); per pixel the largest channel difference and the count of differing pixels against the fuzzy ranges. Drawn by the release's engine library with its CPU raster (op render, cpu:true), Noto Sans and the Hub's fallback fonts (third_party/fonts), page scripts on BubblePopJS; reftest-wait honoured for up to 6 s of page time (TIMEOUT after). A reftest is one test, PASS or not, as on wpt.fyi.

validity.rules: every shard present; every test has a status; ERROR (harness) under 0.5% of tests
